recipe.name: Marry Me Shrimp Pasta
recipe.description: This Marry Me shrimp pasta is filled with tender, seasoned shrimp, a rich, creamy sun-dried tomato sauce, and al dente penne pasta.

video.name: Marry Me Shrimp Pasta
video.description: Marry Me shrimp pasta takes the classic, creamy Marr Me dish and replaces chicken with tender, perfectly cooked shrimp.

recipeIngredient: 1 1/2 tbsp sun-dried tomato oil (from the sun-dried tomato jar)

itemListElement.text: Boil the pasta according to the package directions for al dente while you cook the shrimp.
itemListElement.name: Boil

itemListElement.text: Toss the shrimp with the paprika, Italian seasoning, salt, and pepper in a medium bowl until they're evenly coated.
itemListElement.name: Season

itemListElement.text: Heat the sun-dried tomato oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Then, cook the shrimp for two minutes on both sides until they are pink, opaque, and C-shaped. If they're O-shaped, you've cooked them too long.
itemListElement.name: Cook

itemListElement.text: Set the cooked shrimp aside to cool.
itemListElement.name: Cool

itemListElement.text: Melt the butter in the same pan over medium-low heat. Then, add the garlic, onion, sun-dried tomatoes, tomato paste, Italian seasoning, paprika, salt, and dried basil. Cook the mixture for about two minutes until fragrant.
itemListElement.name: Saute

itemListElement.text: Add the flour to the aromatics and stir well. Then, add the broth, heavy cream, and spinach. Stir and cook until the sauce thickens and the spinach starts to wilt - about 5 minutes. Then, add the parmesan cheese and stir until melted.
itemListElement.name: Make the Sauce

itemListElement.text: Carefully mix the pasta into the sauce. Then, add the shrimp and gently stir again. Garnish with fresh basil, and enjoy.
itemListElement.name: Mix

This is amazing, I added some pan seared chicken and wow. My family absolutely loved it. My son said it was better than the pasta we get from his restaurant. It will definitely be added to the dinner rotation. It’s packed full of flavor and very easy to make…just follow the tutorial!!😊
It came out so good! I added 2 cups Italian blend cheese to my sauce instead of the 1 cup of Parmesan. My Very picky 7 year old ate it all up, so that is the for sure stamp of approval 😁

This recipe was a huge hit with my family of six which in general is a feat on it's own.  I only made one adjustment.  Instead of prawns I used a marinara mix as one child doesn't eat prawns.  We loved the flavours.  Thank you for this recipe and it will be added to the meal rotation. 😋
This worked exactly as written, and my family loved it so much. I did pop it in the oven for 5 minutes after topping with Parmesan cheese however it was amazing before that ✨💚💪🏽
